text:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : n ^ 2 % 3 = 0 ∨ n ^ 2 % 3 = 1 ∨ n ^ 2 % 3 = 2 := mod_self_three
  cases h1 with a
  · rw [a] at h
    rw [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 1 := mod_add_right h1
    rw [h2] at h
    contradiction
  · rw [a] at h
    rw [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 2 := mod_add_right h1
    rw [h2] at h
    contradiction
  · rw [a] at h
    rw [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 0 := mod_add_right h1
    rw [h2] at h
    contradiction
